_doc: Slack is Northstar's only notification channel. All channels are public. Mobile and email notifications are off for every scheduled task. Replace the ids with your own channels if you fork.

daily.name: #northstar-daily
daily.use: Daily, weekly and monthly 'ready' messages with stats, and one line when a part is missing

polls.name: #northstar-polls
polls.use: Weekly New in AI poll (Thursdays) and monthly research and fundamentals poll (the 25th)

ask.name: #northstar-ask
ask.use: Occasional questions to the user, only when the answer changes what gets made

general.name: #general
general.use: Announcements: changes to Northstar itself, the quarterly review

random.name: #random
random.use: One light thing a day: an xkcd link or an original joke
